items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock amid softer EV demand in China, elevated inventory levels and expectations of increased supply from mine restarts and capacity expansions.

items.snippet: On its second-quarter earnings call, Albemarle Corporation reported that global lithium consumption grew 45% year-over-year through May 2026, while new supply additions lagged; lithium carbonate inventories stood at under three weeks.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia has seen profits soar as unrelenting demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. US-headquartered Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.

items.headline: AI Energy Storage Demand Ignites Lithium Prices, Lithium Mining Giants See "Second Growth Engine"
items.snippet: Albemarle's total sales in the second quarter rose by 31% year-on-year, adjusted EBITDA surged by 155% year-on-year, and revenue from the energy storage chemicals segment increased by nearly 80% year-on-year.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand is up 45% through May, primarily driven by continued strength in stationary storage. We are increasing our 2026 and 2030 stationary storage forecast ranges due to that strong demand. Lithium demand growth continues to outstrip supply growth.
